title: documentation.testing affected_specs() answer
description: The answer of require('documentation.testing').affected_specs and of scripts/affected_specs.lua, contract version 1 (docs/testing-contract.md). A consumer must treat an unknown version as 'no answer' and run everything.

specs.description: Spec files to run, repository-relative, sorted.

modules.description: The changed modules and their transitive dependents.

unplaced_specs.description: Specs the graph cannot place (a computed require, or none of their requires is in the map). Never provably unaffected: run them.

ignored.description: Changed files that cannot affect a spec (documentation, assets, the generated map).

complete.description: true when a narrowed selection can be trusted: the graph is not stale and no blocking gap exists.

cross_repo.description: Consumers (sibling checkouts) affected by the change, or that could not be measured. Empty without a 'consumers' directory.

map.description: Repository-relative path of the module map.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC: the commit time of the map, the file's mtime when it is uncommitted.

commit.description: Full sha of the newest commit touching the map file; absent when uncommitted.

head.description: Full sha of HEAD; absent outside a repository.

stale.description: Code changed after the map was written, or its age could not be established.

verified.description: true when 'stale' was settled by a rescan (verify = true).

dirty.description: The source tree has uncommitted changes.

cross_repo_note.description: Set when a consumers directory was given but could not be looked at.

repo.description: Directory name of the consumer checkout.

measured.description: false: the consumer could not be analysed. Not measured is not 'not affected'.

reason.description: Why it could not be measured.

stale.description: The consumer's own map is older than its code.

uncovered.description: Affected, but no spec covers it.
